sonnet.problem: Card 11 already calls Gideon 'Jerubbaal son of Joash'. That tells the baker Joash is Gideon's father, so the answer 'father' on this fill-in-the-blank is given away earlier. A baker doesn't have to read the passage to get it right.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
